title: Exploring Fusion Techniques in Multimodal AI-Based Recruitment: Insights from FairCVdb
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on measuring fairness and bias implications of multimodal fusion techniques in AI-based recruitment based on the protected attributes of gender and ethnicity.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on gender and ethnicity bias.
